svg.aria-label: Typical dye intermediates (made from the crudes)
svg.title: Typical dye intermediates (made from the crudes)
svg.desc: Gallery of dye intermediates: aniline, nitrobenzene, sulphanilic acid, dimethylaniline, beta-naphthol, naphthionic acid, benzidine, anthraquinone, phthalic anhydride
svg.text: Typical dye intermediates (made from the crudes)
Intermediates are not dyes themselves but are converted into dyes by diazotisation, coupling, condensation, etc.
